_meta.purpose: THE source of truth for which Claude model IDs are current at BBS. canonical-facts.md quotes it and check_claude_md.py reads it, so the fact and the checker that enforces it can never disagree.
_meta.why_a_file: This list was previously written down twice — once in canonical-facts.md and once as a regex inside the checker. It went stale in both, and the checker kept telling authors to write the superseded ID. When a canonical fact has a checker, the checker is part of the fact.
_meta.refresh: scripts/refresh_models.py rewrites this from the Anthropic Models API (GET /v1/models). Run it by hand, or let .github/workflows/refresh-models.yml do it weekly and open a PR.
_meta.generated_by: manual — first entry, verified against the claude-api skill's current-models table

roles.opus: Hardest reasoning, architecture, long-horizon agent work.
roles.sonnet: The quote bot's specialist tier — escalate_to_specialist routes here.
roles.haiku: The quote bot's fast tier — clear lookups; no effort and no extended thinking.

known_not_adopted.claude-fable-5-1: Anthropic's most capable widely released model. Priced above Opus tier. BBS has not adopted it; writing it is a deliberate choice, not an error.

rules.no_date_suffix: Model IDs are complete as written. Never append a date — `claude-opus-5-20260401` is not a thing. Any `claude-*-20YYMMDD` is an error.
rules.current_only: BBS writes only the three IDs under `current`. A superseded ID is a FAIL; a known-not-adopted ID is a WARN, because it may be deliberate.
